items.title: AWS Certificate Manager to Discontinue Email Validation for Public Certificates
items.description: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) has announced plans to permanently discontinue email-based domain control validation (DCV) for public certificate renewals by September 30, 2027. The deprecation aligns AWS cloud infrastructure with global trust mandates established by the Certificate Authority and Browser (CA/B) Forum, requiring cloud architects, DevOps engineers, and security teams to transition…
